title: Archer pawn: hold the aim camera, turn with it, aim at screen centre
intro: About 1 minute, two parts, each started with End. Arisen must be an Archer; an Archer pawn in the party. Part 2 is an experiment on the camera (save first if you like).

steps.each_frame:
if not _G.AIMY then
  local A = { log = {}, blocked = 0, req = 0 }
  _G.AIMY = A
  local function note(s) A.last = s; if #A.log < 120 then A.log[#A.log + 1] = string.format("%.2f %s", os.clock(), s) end end
  local function obj(a) local ok, o = pcall(sdk.to_managed_object, a); if ok and o then pcall(o.add_ref, o); return o end return nil end
  local td = sdk.find_type_definition("app.MainCameraController"); local m = td and td:get_method("switchCamera(app.CameraDefine.ControlType, app.CameraSwitchInterpParam, app.PostEffectSetting, app.CameraDefine.ToPlayerCameraOption)")
  if m then
    sdk.hook(m, function(args)
      local ok, r = pcall(function()
        local ct = sdk.to_int64(args[3]) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        if A.mine then note("ours: type " .. ct); return nil end
        if ct ~= 7 and A.hold and os.clock() < (A.hold_until or 0) then
          A.blocked = A.blocked + 1
          if A.blocked <= 3 then note("BLOCKED the game's switch to type " .. ct) end
          return sdk.PreHookResult.SKIP_ORIGINAL
        end
        local e = { ct = ct, opt = sdk.to_int64(args[6]) & 0xFFFFFFFF, interp = obj(args[4]), pfx = obj(args[5]) }
        note(string.format("game: type %d opt %d interp %s", ct, e.opt, tostring(e.interp ~= nil)))
        if ct == 7 then A.enter = e; A.want_exit = true elseif A.want_exit then A.exit = e; A.want_exit = false end
        return nil
      end)
      if ok and r then return r end
    end, function(r) return r end)
    note("hook installed")
  else note("NO METHOD") end
else
  local A = _G.AIMY
  A.hold, A.hold_until, A.p_t0, A.p_res, A.t_err, A.S0, A.S1, A.diff_n, A.s_done, A.b_t0, A.phase, A.aim_t, A.req_t = nil
  A.blocked, A.req = 0, 0
end
_G.AIMY.snap = function()
  local S = {}
  local function add(o, name, depth)
    if not o then return end
    local t, d = o:get_type_definition(), 0
    while t and d < 4 do
      for _, f in ipairs(t:get_fields()) do
        local oks, st = pcall(f.is_static, f)
        if not (oks and st) then
          local fn = f:get_name()
          local ok, v = pcall(o.get_field, o, fn)
          if ok then
            local tv = type(v)
            if tv == "number" or tv == "boolean" or tv == "string" then S[name .. "." .. fn] = tostring(v)
            elseif tv == "userdata" then
              local okn, tn = pcall(function() return v:get_type_definition():get_full_name() end)
              S[name .. "." .. fn] = okn and ("<" .. tostring(tn) .. ">") or "<value>"
              if depth > 0 and okn and (tostring(tn):find("InputProcessor") or tostring(tn):find("HoldDownChecker")) then add(v, name .. "." .. fn, depth - 1) end
            else S[name .. "." .. fn] = "nil" end
          end
        end
      end
      t = t:get_parent_type(); d = d + 1
    end
  end
  pcall(function()
    local gm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.GuiManager")
    local aim = gm:get_field("Aim")
    add(aim, "ui.Aim", 0)
    if aim then
      local go = aim:call("get_GameObject")
      S["ui.Aim.go.DrawSelf"] = tostring(go:call("get_DrawSelf")); S["ui.Aim.go.UpdateSelf"] = tostring(go:call("get_UpdateSelf"))
    end
    local a = H.arisen()
    add(a:get_GameObject():call("getComponent(System.Type)", sdk.typeof("app.Player")), "Player", 1)
    add(a:call("get_Human"), "Human", 0)
  end)
  return S
end

steps.text: 1/2 BASELINE. As the ARISEN (Archer, bow out). Press End, do NOT aim for 2 s, then hold aim when told

steps.each_frame:
local A = _G.AIMY; if not A then return end
A.b_t0 = A.b_t0 or os.clock()
if not A.S0 and os.clock() - A.b_t0 > 1.0 then A.S0 = A.snap() end

steps.text: ARISEN: HOLD AIM now... keep holding
steps.each_frame:
local A = _G.AIMY; if not A then return end
A.b1_t0 = A.b1_t0 or os.clock()
if not A.S1 and os.clock() - A.b1_t0 > 3.0 and A.S0 then
  A.S1 = A.snap()
  local diff, ui0, ui1, n = {}, {}, {}, 0
  for k, v in pairs(A.S1) do
    if A.S0[k] ~= v then diff[k] = tostring(A.S0[k]) .. " -> " .. v; n = n + 1 end
    if k:sub(1, 6) == "ui.Aim" then ui1[k] = v; ui0[k] = A.S0[k] end
  end
  A.diff_n = n
  pcall(json.dump_file, "DPC_probe_aim_diff.json", { changed = diff, ui_idle = ui0, ui_aiming = ui1 })
end

steps.text: 2/2 EXPERIMENT. Possess the ARCHER pawn (F6 / F7). Press End, then HOLD AIM for 15 s, turn the camera and shoot. Three 5 s phases shown on screen: 1 camera only, 2 + body follows camera, 3 + arrows to screen centre. Note what works in each
PAWN: HOLD AIM, turn the camera, shoot. Watch the 'phase' line
steps.each_frame:
local A = _G.AIMY; if not A then return end
A.p_t0 = A.p_t0 or os.clock()
local now = os.clock(); local dt = now - A.p_t0
A.phase = dt < 5 and "1: camera only" or (dt < 10 and "2: + body follows camera" or "3: + arrows to screen centre")
local cm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CameraManager"); local mcc = cm and cm:call("getMainCameraController", 0); if not mcc then return end
local ch = mcc:call("get_TargetCharacter"); if not ch then return end
local up = tostring(H.node(ch, 1) or "")
if up:find("Job02", 1, true) then A.aim_t = now end
local aiming = A.aim_t ~= nil and (now - A.aim_t) < 0.4
local cur = mcc:get_field("_CurrentCameraController")
local on_aim = cur ~= nil and cur:get_type_definition():get_name():find("Aim", 1, true) ~= nil
local e, x = A.enter0, A.exit0
if aiming then
  A.hold = true; A.hold_until = now + 0.5
  if not e then A.p_res = "no captured aim switch to replay"
  elseif not on_aim and now >= (A.req_t or 0) then
    A.req_t = now + 0.5; A.req = A.req + 1
    A.mine = true
    local ok, err = pcall(mcc.call, mcc, "switchCamera(app.CameraDefine.ControlType, app.CameraSwitchInterpParam, app.PostEffectSetting, app.CameraDefine.ToPlayerCameraOption)", 7, e.interp, e.pfx, e.opt)
    A.mine = false
    A.p_res = "aim camera requested ok=" .. tostring(ok) .. (ok and "" or (" " .. tostring(err)))
  end
  if dt >= 5 then
    pcall(function()
      local m = sdk.find_type_definition("app.PlayerInputProcessorDetail"):get_method("getCameraAngleRad")
      ch:call("set_TargetFrontAngleDeg(System.Single)", math.deg(m:call(nil)) + 0.0)
    end)
  end
  if dt >= 10 then
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
      local tr = sdk.get_primary_camera():call("get_GameObject"):call("get_Transform")
      local p, z = tr:call("get_Position"), tr:call("get_WorldMatrix")[2]
      ch:call("set_AimTargetPosition", Vector3f.new(p.x - z.x * 60.0, p.y - z.y * 60.0, p.z - z.z * 60.0))
    end)
    if not ok and not A.t_err then A.t_err = tostring(err) end
  end
elseif A.hold then
  A.hold = false
  if on_aim then
    local s = x or e
    A.mine = true
    pcall(mcc.call, mcc, "switchCamera(app.CameraDefine.ControlType, app.CameraSwitchInterpParam, app.PostEffectSetting, app.CameraDefine.ToPlayerCameraOption)", x and x.ct or 0, s and s.interp, s and s.pfx, x and x.opt or 0)
    A.mine = false
  end
end

steps.text: Release aim. Camera back to normal
steps.each_frame:
local A = _G.AIMY; if not A then return end
if not A.x_done or A.hold then
  A.x_done = true; A.hold = false; A.hold_until = 0
  local cm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CameraManager"); local mcc = cm and cm:call("getMainCameraController", 0); if not mcc then return end
  local cur = mcc:get_field("_CurrentCameraController")
  if cur and cur:get_type_definition():get_name():find("Aim", 1, true) then
    local x, e = A.exit0, A.enter0; local s = x or e
    A.mine = true
    pcall(mcc.call, mcc, "switchCamera(app.CameraDefine.ControlType, app.CameraSwitchInterpParam, app.PostEffectSetting, app.CameraDefine.ToPlayerCameraOption)", x and x.ct or 0, s and s.interp, s and s.pfx, x and x.opt or 0)
    A.mine = false
  end
end

probes.yawd:
local cm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CameraManager"); local mcc = cm and cm:call("getMainCameraController", 0); if not mcc then return nil end
local ch = mcc:call("get_TargetCharacter"); if not ch then return nil end
local z = ch:call("get_Transform"):call("get_AxisZ")
local m = sdk.find_type_definition("app.PlayerInputProcessorDetail"):get_method("getCameraAngleRad")
local d = math.deg(math.atan(z.x, z.z)) - math.deg(m:call(nil))
d = (d + 180) % 360 - 180; return math.abs(d)
